title: Add Immutable Experiment Specification Object to Colab Evidence Protocol
trigger: User requested insertion of an immutable Experiment Specification object containing research question, hypothesis, variables, controls, random seed, parameter space, termination conditions, expected outputs, and interpretation protocol.

excluded: post-hoc validation of existing notebook results

governance_decision.c2_gate_rule: Future Colab Department C2 notebook/result classifications require an immutable pre-execution experiment_spec.json or an explicit governed legacy exception, plus recoverable outputs, manifest/hash integrity, and bounded interpretation.
governance_decision.legacy_note: Previously admitted Notebook 10/11/12 artifacts keep their recorded pre-spec ceilings but require backfilled or superseding experiment specifications before further replication or promotion review.

claim_humility_review.bounded_statement: The specification records pre-execution design intent and interpretation limits. It does not validate outputs, approve tools, or establish external physical claims.
